item.title: Costume☆Player
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Art
  • 発売日: 2006-02-17
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: こすちゅーむ☆ぷれいやー
  • 英語名: Costume☆Player

别名

  • Kosu Chi Mu ☆ Pureiyaa

あらすじ

There’s both a male and female perspective to play in this game.

The guy is very much the otaku, but his social rank is elevated very much so when he finds a girl looking for a place to live. He agrees to help her out and the two of them start living together (much to dismay of his other–few–lady acquaintances).

item.title: Shinku no Soiree - Cardinal Soiree
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Art
  • 発売日: 2005-03-18
  • スコア: 6.709999999999999/10 (6 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 深紅のソワレ cardinal soiree
  • 英語名: Shinku no Soiree - Cardinal Soiree

别名

  • cardinal soriee

あらすじ

The protagonist awakes to find himself washed up on a beach. All he remembers is his name and knowledge about circuses. All he owns is a deck of cards and a compass. And lying next to him is a girl he doesn’t know.

The two of them look for help, but the townspeople won’t have anything to do with them. While at a loss for what to do, they meet a lone man, who invites them to work for his circus company. Due to his circus knowledge the protagonist is hired as an instructor. Will he lead his performers to an artistic circus that gives his audience dreams? Or will the curtain rise on a carnal soiree of lust?
